role: Sourced library and Makefile include holding the single definition of XCODEBUILD_PINNED, the xcodebuild flag (-onlyUsePackageVersionsFromResolvedFile) that holds a build, test, archive or destination listing to the package versions in the committed Package.resolved.
toplevel: One NAME=value assignment, XCODEBUILD_PINNED=-onlyUsePackageVersionsFromResolvedFile, written so it parses the same as bash and as make. Sourced by select_simulator_destination.sh, run_tests_with_coverage.sh, check_thread_sanitizer.sh and verify_tests_fail.sh, which pass "$XCODEBUILD_PINNED" to xcodebuild; included by the Makefile, whose test and release-build targets pass $(XCODEBUILD_PINNED). Inline xcodebuild calls in performance.yml, security.yml and testflight.yml pass the flag literally and name this file in a comment. check_xcodebuild_pinned.sh requires this exact assignment.
